base: original source: static/portraits/npc/lee_mi-na/neutral.webp (728x1104, transparent BG, semi-realistic). Long straight white hair, navy double-breasted school uniform blazer, white collar + tie, red ribbon bow. Face-only inpaint; outfit/hair/body/pose never regenerated.
method: img2img inpaint only (no txt2img). Original alpha re-applied via putalpha after each generation.

denoising_strength.note: 0.5 keeps skin tone and lip color within tolerance. 0.75 was rejected: stray hair strand artifacts appear over the forehead.

alwayson_note: 'random' script MUST be disabled or SD randomizes generation params per API call, producing glitchy faces.
mask_note: ellipse centered at (W*0.725, alpha_bbox_top + H*0.105) with radii (W*0.085, H*0.047), GaussianBlur(5). Eyes ~top+8%H, mouth ~top+12%H, chin ~top+13.5%H, face x 66-79%W.
id_prompt: 1girl, 19 year old korean high school girl, natural fair skin tone, (long straight white hair:1.2), (red eyes:1.5), semi-realistic, photorealistic detail

rejected.1.15: eyes came out brown/dark - base red eye color was lost entirely
rejected.1.8: red iris strong but a red rim/glow bled onto the eyelids (eyeliner look) and expression tokens were suppressed

red_eyes_calibration.note: red eyes weight competes with expression tokens; 1.5 is the balance point.

negative_prompt: (red eyeliner:1.4), (red eyeshadow:1.4), (bloodshot eyes:1.3), blood, blood tears, (red lips:1.3), lipstick, heavy makeup, (pale washed out skin:1.3), grey eyes, blue eyes, green eyes, anime, cartoon, (unibrow:1.3), deformed face, extra eyes, bad anatomy, lowres, blurry, text, watermark, worst quality, low quality
negative_note: anti-bleed terms (red eyeliner/eyeshadow/bloodshot/blood tears/red lips/pale washed out skin) are mandatory - without them face inpaint turns into horror makeup.

validation.skin_metric: median brightness of skin-like pixels (R>150 and R-B<60) inside the face ellipse; a fixed-point cheek sample is unreliable because a smile shifts the cheek.

embedded_metadata.png: PNG tEXt chunk key 'parameters' (readable in SD WebUI PNG Info tab)
